name: Mukhyamantri Mahalakshmi Kit Yojana
benefit: In the state, after the institutional delivery of a pregnant woman, the following benefits will be provided: - The woman will receive one Mahalakshmi kit for the birth of each of her first two girl children. - In the case of twins, the woman will be given one Mahalakshmi kit, and each child will receive a separate Mahalakshmi kit.
_eligibility_text: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The beneficiary must be a pregnant woman registered with an Anganwadi Centre and eligible to receive a Mahalakshmi Kit after delivery. 1. The beneficiary must not be an income tax payer.
